newsitem.title: INDIA: CRICKET-KAPOOR CHECKS SOUTH AFRICAN RUN HUNT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-KAPOOR CHECKS SOUTH AFRICAN RUN HUNT.

text.p: Offspinner Aashish Kapoor struck twice as South Africa scored 108 runs for three wickets in reply to India's 237 at tea on the second day of their third and final test on Monday.
Kapoor exploited a slow turning pitch to get rid of Herschelle Gibbs and opener Gary Kirsten for just 19 runs in an eight-over spell.
Kapoor bowled Gibbs through a bat-pad gap when Gibbs had scored a patient 17 off 67 balls. Kirsten, who made an elegant 43, fell to a fine catch by Woorkeri Raman at forward short-leg.
At tea, Darryl Cullinan was batting on 19 and skipper Hansie Cronje on eight.
Leg-spinner Anil Kumble had got opener Andrew Hudson leg before wicket for 15 before lunch, when the visitors were 34 for one.
Earlier, India were all out at the end of a fine spell by legspinner Paul Adams, who returned with a career best six for 55.
